description: Main source file for a Flutter-based grocery shopping mobile app, defining the app's root widget, home screen with various UI components, routing, and navigation structure.

classes.name: GroceryApp
classes.description: Root widget initializing theme, routes, and home screen for the grocery app.

classes.name: GroceryHomeScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main home screen with app bar, search, banners, product listings, categories, and bottom navigation.

classes.name: _Badge
classes.description: Widget displaying a circular badge with text, used for cart item count.

classes.name: _CircleIconDot
classes.description: Minimal circular dot widget, used as a placeholder for icons.

classes.name: _LabelValueChevron
classes.description: Component displaying a label with a value and a chevron icon, typically for address and ETA info.

classes.name: _BannerCard
classes.description: Widget for displaying promotional banners with an emblem and text overlay.

classes.name: _ProductCard
classes.description: Card widget representing an individual product with image, title, subtitle, price badge, and add button.

classes.name: _PriceBadge
classes.description: Widget showing product price and unit within a styled badge.

classes.name: _AddButton
classes.description: Animated floating plus button to add products to cart.

classes.name: _CategoryChip
classes.description: Clickable chip widget representing a product category.

classes.name: _BottomNav
classes.description: Custom bottom navigation bar with buttons for Home, Favourites, Categories, and More.

classes.name: _NavHome
classes.description: Widget for the 'Home' button in bottom navigation, styled as a circle.

classes.name: _NavItem
classes.description: Generic widget for navigation items with icon and label.

classes.name: PlaceholderScreen
classes.description: Simple placeholder page for stub routes in the app.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point, runs the Flutter app with GroceryApp as root widget.
